aboutGame.title: What is ShredDead?
paragraphs: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game from Weird Penguin Games. It focuses on progression with no lose conditions, pitting players against endless waves while they collect loot, grow a skill tree, and evolve the zombies.

You can fight directly, equip grunts with loot to help handle the waves, and use an industrial shredder to dispose of zombies. ShredDead launched on Steam for Windows and macOS on October 26, 2026, and this wiki collects practical guides for its core systems.

faq.title: ShredDead FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about ShredDead gameplay, progression, and platforms.

items.question: What is ShredDead?
items.answer: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game from Weird Penguin Games, built around endless waves and progression with no lose conditions.

items.question: Does ShredDead have a lose condition?
items.answer: No. The official ShredDead description says the game has no lose conditions, so you can keep experimenting with its progression systems.

items.question: Can I equip grunts in ShredDead?
items.answer: Yes. ShredDead zombies drop loot that you can use to equip your grunts, and those grunts can help handle the endless waves.

items.question: What does the ShredDead skill tree do?
items.answer: The ShredDead skill tree is a progression system for improving how you eliminate zombies, with branches you can explore alongside loot and grunt upgrades.

items.question: What is the shredder used for in ShredDead?
items.answer: ShredDead features an industrial shredder as a way to dispose of zombies that reach your outpost defenses.

items.question: Which platforms support ShredDead?
items.answer: ShredDead is listed for Windows and macOS on Steam. Linux is not listed as a supported platform for ShredDead.

items.question: When did ShredDead release?
items.answer: ShredDead released on Steam on October 26, 2026, according to the official store listing.
